verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented capability for downloading files from sites, uploading files to them, or retrieving artifacts after a run. The only related items are example task prompts in the README (filling a job application with a resume, exporting followers as a CSV). These are illustrative tasks, not documented file-transfer or artifact-retrieval features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can download files from and upload files to the sites it operates, with the artifacts retrievable afterwards
